result.reason: The revised language implements the preferred mutual cap quantum, including the USD 1,000,000 floor, without changing the existing aggregation structure. However, the supplied operative language does not establish the required indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, payment-obligations clarification, or the contents of “Excluded Claims.” The margin comment cannot supply those protections, so neither the preferred nor fallback carve-out position is demonstrably met. In addition, “all amounts” is broader and less precise than the playbook’s “fees” formulation and could include taxes, expenses, damages, or other non-fee amounts.
